crawlerEvidenceAccounting.meaning: Provider-verified crawler request counts are cumulative over the append-only fingerprint ledger. This rule does not apply to user-agent-only candidates, referrals, Common Crawl results, or Wayback results.

domainCanonicalizationEvidence.meaning: The Hong Kong host redirects HTTP to HTTPS and exposes the expected self-canonical URL. The GitHub Pages apex host serves content directly over HTTP, both www entry points lead to the HTTP apex, and the HTTPS www entry point downgrades to HTTP. GitHub Pages reports https_enforced=false. This is a technical canonicalization and transport-security defect; it does not negate the observed Yandex brand result or prove any search ranking effect. Enabling Enforce HTTPS requires repository-owner administration, and no DNS, CDN, Cloudflare, or Pages setting was changed by this observation.

evidenceBoundary: Provider-verified requests prove only access by the named crawler. Bytespider candidates are separately labeled user-agent-only and identity-unverified; they do not prove Doubao or ByteDance access. Discovery-file access is not content ingestion. Wayback CDX records prove public historical captures only. Attributed requests do not prove a human visitor. Coordinated multi-profile bursts and internally inconsistent browser identities are classified as suspected automation. Public-search non-results are observations for the stated queries and time. None of this proves indexing, retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or non-brand recommendation. No prompt was sent to Doubao.
